title: MediaAvatarAdoptResult
description: media.avatar-adopt-result@1: the answer of POST /internal/avatar-adopt on OpenVibe.Media: { ok: true, ref }, the active reference the slot now holds. A reference is released, never deleted, so Media keeps the history of the objects a person's picture moved through.

object_id.description: The avatar object (med_…) the slot points at.

subject.description: The person (usr_…) when the product knows it; Media refuses an object owned by someone else.

product.description: The product whose profile holds the picture: network (users.avatar_url) or live (its own users.avatar_url, a channel banner).

ref.description: The slot in that product: the person's id there, or the id and the slot (for example 42:banner).

created_at.description: When the slot started pointing at the object.

released_at.description: Always null in this answer: the reference is the active one.
